quote.exact_quote: I switched from using the Drunk Elephant LaLa Retro moisturizer to this one several months ago. The DE was lovely, but just so expensive, and I wanted to try something new. This one is still kinda $$$ but it is ultimately cheaper than the DE LaLa. I will continue using it going forward because my skin seems to really like it for my PM routine. My skin feels soft, calm, and hydrated in the morning. It doesn't break me out. My only complaint would be that sometimes I push too hard on the squeeze tube and too much product comes out which feels wasteful. I do prefer the DE LaLa packaging. But it does the job! I recommend it for most folks.

quote.exact_quote: I have combo skin with hormonal breakouts and occasional dryness brought on by tret. This moisturizer keeps my skin hydrated and just looking “better” in a way it’s hard to put my finger on. I stopped using it for a  month and my skin just looked dull. My only complaint is that the packaging is not great. It’s hard to control how much product comes out of the wide opening and also hard to get all of the lotion out of the tube which sucks for such an expensive product. This is actually the reason I took a month off from using it. If they fixed the packaging this would be a 10 star product for me.
